images.name: horf-charm-pair
images.findings: The selected Horf has a pink marker and pink shot toward the other Horf. The other has a red shot toward the player. Both remain counted as hostiles. Skull material stays bone-colored; effect identity relies on its overhead cue.

images.name: horf-recovered
images.findings: Pink marker is gone and a normal red projectile is visible; probe reports zero Charm and one room threat.

images.name: horf-freeze-charm
images.findings: Blue frozen skull, frost spokes and pink marker coexist. Overhead cues are close together; mixed-room/readability acceptance remains open.

limitations: Mostly isolated open-room fixtures, plus one two-Horf scene. Crowded/occluded and varied-angle/zoom acceptance remains open.
The small heart marker reads primarily as a pink overhead shape at this scale; Horf keeps its existing bone material.
Still captures do not certify animation quality, full balance or rendered performance. Startup FPS readouts are not a benchmark.
